Definition: Amatsjah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Amaziah = "Jehovah is mighty"; 1) a king of Judah, son Joash, father of Azariah; 2) a priest of Bethel under Jeroboam II; 3) father of Joshah, of the tribe of Simeon; 4) a Levite tabernacle singer in David's day
